class Solution:
    def convertBiNode(self, root: Optional[TreeNode]) -> Optional[TreeNode]:
        dummy = TreeNode(0)
        self.prev = dummy

        def inorder(node):
            if node is None:
                return
            inorder(node.left)
            node.left = None
            self.prev.right = node
            self.prev = node
            inorder(node.right)

        inorder(root)
        self.prev.right = None
        return dummy.right
